capabilities: open the nearest link to the cursor
open links in new tabs, tab groups, or windows
move the cursor to the next or previous link
work on both desktop and mobile
extras: The author states they rarely use Obsidian anymore; maintenance is limited to security fixes and no new features or non-security bug fixes are planned.
intentEvidence: It essentially operates like the 'Follow link under cursor' command. The only difference is that even if there is no link under the cursor
problem: Obsidian's built-in 'Follow link under cursor' command only works when the cursor is directly on a link, forcing precise cursor placement.
summary: Navigation plugin that opens the link nearest to the cursor, even when no link sits directly under it.
